usage: 魚 (jyu4) is mainly used as a noun to mean fish, including both living fish and fish as food.
You can use 魚 in singular or plural contexts without changing the form, just like 'fish' in English.
It can be combined with measure words like '條' (tiu4) to specify quantity, for example, 一條魚 means one fish.
The word 魚 can be used literally or in idioms and expressions related to fish or fish-like qualities.
When talking about different types of fish, 魚 can be used with descriptors or names, e.g., 金魚 (goldfish).
